title: Soft Ropes of Love
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hosea's people wandered far,
But He still loved them so;
He drew them close with bands of love,
The softest ropes you know.

[Chorus]
Soft ropes of love, soft ropes of love,
He gently pulls me near;
He never yanks, He never shoves,
He holds me close and dear.

[Verse 2]
The farmers long ago would lead
Their animals with rope;
But Father leads His own with love,
A hug that's full of hope.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
A yoke is heavy on the neck,
A big wood bar to bear;
He lifts it off like farmers kind,
And sets down food right there.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When Wren saw someone shy and small,
She did not tug his sleeve;
She slid the good blue cushion near,
And waited, would not leave.

[Chorus]
mood: Drawing-near music. A slow, even pull under the voice, like a soft rope taken up hand over hand and a small step taken toward it each time. Cello holding one low warm line underneath while nylon guitar answers above it, the two in quiet conversation. Nothing tugs or hurries; it loosens a little with each verse, shoulders dropping, and ends light and settled in the middle of the day.
